-- Task 12 finite current-observed catalog input preparation. NOT EXECUTED.
-- One SELECT; no custom function invocation, business rows or mutations.
-- Governance metadata exceptions authorized by root: allowlisted table
-- classification rows, and migration-ledger count/tail only (no statements).
-- 10 new + 13 retained relations; 13 new + 17 retained signatures.
-- Function definitions additionally include DIRECT triggers of 10 new relations.
-- Dependency records are DIRECT only; referenced functions are not recursed into.
-- Table/function projections below are byte-identical to the prior wave queries.
-- Sequence configuration bigint fields are text; no sequence state is read.
-- Prior report/pins remain frozen. Historical source admission stays BLOCKED.
with named_targets(schema_name,relation_name,test_root) as (values
  ('public','invoice_provider_events',true),
  ('public','invoice_export_items',true),
  ('public','invoice_export_runs',true),
  ('public','event_outbox',true),
  ('public','pricing_runs',true),
  ('public','partner_exports',true),
  ('public','portfolios',true),
  ('public','portfolio_monthly_settlements',true),
  ('public','price_plan_versions',true),
  ('public','portfolio_settlement_audit_log',true),
  ('public','customer_invoices',false),
  ('public','billing_underlays',false),
  ('public','audit_logs',false),
  ('public','webhook_deliveries',false),
  ('public','domain_events',false),
  ('public','webhook_subscriptions',false),
  ('public','companies',false),
  ('public','customers',false),
  ('public','customer_contracts',false),
  ('public','customer_sites',false),
  ('public','metering_points',false),
  ('public','contract_price_snapshots',false),
  ('auth','users',false)
),
rels as (
  select c.oid,c.relnamespace,c.relname,n.nspname,t.test_root
  from named_targets t
  join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.nspname=t.schema_name
  join pg_catalog.pg_class c on c.relnamespace=n.oid and c.relname=t.relation_name
),
expected_functions(signature,profile) as (values
  ('public.gridex_claim_invoice_provider_events(uuid,text[],integer,uuid,integer)','new'),
  ('public.gridex_protect_sent_invoice_export_items()','new'),
  ('private.gridex_require_locked_pricing_run_for_invoice_export()','new'),
  ('public.gridex_suppress_retired_onboarding_outbox_v1()','new'),
  ('private.gridex_emit_partner_resource_event_v2(uuid,uuid,text,text,text,jsonb,text)','new'),
  ('public.gridex_protect_locked_pricing_runs()','new'),
  ('public.gridex_inherit_pricing_run_energy_flow()','new'),
  ('public.gridex_reject_locked_price_version_mutation()','new'),
  ('public.gridex_sync_portfolio_monthly_prices_from_version_trigger()','new'),
  ('public.gridex_sync_portfolio_monthly_prices_for_version(uuid)','new'),
  ('public.gridex_guard_portfolio_settlement_immutability()','new'),
  ('public.gridex_audit_portfolio_settlement_write()','new'),
  ('public.gridex_portfolio_audit_immutable()','new'),
  ('private.gridex_partner_invoice_event_v2()','retained'),
  ('public.ensure_customer_invoice_reference_v1()','retained'),
  ('public.gridex_assert_company_operational_for_write()','retained'),
  ('public.gridex_audit_critical_row_change()','retained'),
  ('public.gridex_billing_underlays_company_guard()','retained'),
  ('public.gridex_enforce_billing_underlay_price_area()','retained'),
  ('public.gridex_enforce_customer_contract_chain_v1()','retained'),
  ('public.gridex_guard_billing_underlay_exact_refs()','retained'),
  ('public.gridex_guard_portfolio_invoice_evidence()','retained'),
  ('public.gridex_normalize_audit_context_v1()','retained'),
  ('public.gridex_normalize_billing_energy_flow()','retained'),
  ('public.gridex_reject_billing_configuration_snapshot_mutation()','retained'),
  ('public.gridex_sync_underlay_invoice_projection_v1()','retained'),
  ('public.set_updated_at_timestamp()','retained'),
  ('public.gridex_assert_same_company(uuid,uuid,text,text)','retained'),
  ('extensions.digest(text,text)','retained'),
  ('extensions.digest(bytea,text)','retained')
),
objects(classid,objid) as (
  select 'pg_catalog.pg_class'::regclass,r.oid from rels r
  union select 'pg_catalog.pg_policy'::regclass,p.oid from pg_catalog.pg_policy p where p.polrelid in(select oid from rels)
  union select 'pg_catalog.pg_attrdef'::regclass,d.oid from pg_catalog.pg_attrdef d where d.adrelid in(select oid from rels)
  union select 'pg_catalog.pg_constraint'::regclass,c.oid from pg_catalog.pg_constraint c where c.conrelid in(select oid from rels)
  union select 'pg_catalog.pg_class'::regclass,i.indexrelid from pg_catalog.pg_index i where i.indrelid in(select oid from rels)
  union select 'pg_catalog.pg_rewrite'::regclass,r.oid from pg_catalog.pg_rewrite r where r.ev_class in(select oid from rels)
  union select 'pg_catalog.pg_trigger'::regclass,t.oid from pg_catalog.pg_trigger t where t.tgrelid in(select oid from rels)
),
deps as (
  select d.* from pg_catalog.pg_depend d join objects o on o.classid=d.classid and o.objid=d.objid
),
function_oids as (
  select pg_catalog.to_regprocedure(signature)::oid oid from expected_functions
  union select t.tgfoid from pg_catalog.pg_trigger t where t.tgrelid in(select oid from rels where test_root)
),
function_deps as (
  select d.* from pg_catalog.pg_depend d
  where d.classid='pg_catalog.pg_proc'::regclass and d.objid in(select oid from function_oids)
),
selected_types as (
  select distinct a.atttypid oid from pg_catalog.pg_attribute a
  where a.attrelid in(select oid from rels) and a.attnum>0 and not a.attisdropped
),
root_fks as (
  select f.* from pg_catalog.pg_constraint f
  where f.contype='f' and f.conrelid in(select oid from rels)
),
parent_oids as (select distinct confrelid oid from root_fks),
sequence_oids as (
  select s.oid from pg_catalog.pg_class s
  join pg_catalog.pg_depend d on d.classid='pg_catalog.pg_class'::regclass and d.objid=s.oid
  where s.relkind='S' and d.refclassid='pg_catalog.pg_class'::regclass and d.refobjid in(select oid from rels)
  union select s.oid from deps d
  join pg_catalog.pg_class s on d.refclassid='pg_catalog.pg_class'::regclass and d.refobjid=s.oid
  where s.relkind='S'
)
select jsonb_build_object(
 'observed_at', clock_timestamp(),
 'database', current_database(),
 'server_version', current_setting('server_version'),
 'ledger', (select jsonb_build_object('count',count(*),'tail',max(version)) from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations),
 'roles', (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',rolname,'superuser',rolsuper,'inherit',rolinherit,'create_role',rolcreaterole,'create_db',rolcreatedb,'login',rolcanlogin,'replication',rolreplication,'bypass_rls',rolbypassrls) order by rolname) from pg_catalog.pg_roles),
 'memberships', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('role',parent.rolname,'member',child.rolname,'grantor',grantor.rolname,'admin',m.admin_option,'inherit',m.inherit_option,'set',m.set_option) order by parent.rolname,child.rolname), '[]'::jsonb) from pg_catalog.pg_auth_members m join pg_catalog.pg_roles parent on parent.oid=m.roleid join pg_catalog.pg_roles child on child.oid=m.member left join pg_catalog.pg_roles grantor on grantor.oid=m.grantor),
 'default_acls', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('owner',pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(d.defaclrole),'schema',n.nspname,'object_type',d.defaclobjtype,'acl',d.defaclacl::text) order by pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(d.defaclrole),n.nspname,d.defaclobjtype), '[]'::jsonb) from pg_catalog.pg_default_acl d left join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.oid=d.defaclnamespace),
 'missing_relations',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) order by t.schema_name,t.relation_name),'[]'::jsonb) from named_targets t where not exists(select 1 from rels r where r.nspname=t.schema_name and r.relname=t.relation_name)),
 'dependencies',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('object_class',d.classid::regclass::text,'object_oid',d.objid,'object_subid',d.objsubid,'reference_class',d.refclassid::regclass::text,'reference_oid',d.refobjid,'reference_subid',d.refobjsubid,'type',d.deptype,'object',pg_catalog.pg_describe_object(d.classid,d.objid,d.objsubid),'reference',pg_catalog.pg_describe_object(d.refclassid,d.refobjid,d.refobjsubid)) order by d.classid,d.objid,d.objsubid,d.refclassid,d.refobjid,d.refobjsubid),'[]'::jsonb) from deps d),
 'types',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('oid',t.oid,'schema',n.nspname,'name',t.typname,'kind',t.typtype,'base_type',t.typbasetype,'not_null',t.typnotnull,'default',t.typdefault,'owner',pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(t.typowner),'acl',t.typacl::text,'enum_labels',(select jsonb_agg(e.enumlabel order by e.enumsortorder) from pg_catalog.pg_enum e where e.enumtypid=t.oid),'domain_constraints',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',c.conname,'definition',pg_catalog.pg_get_constraintdef(c.oid,true),'validated',c.convalidated) order by c.conname) from pg_catalog.pg_constraint c where c.contypid=t.oid)) order by n.nspname,t.typname),'[]'::jsonb) from pg_catalog.pg_type t join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.oid=t.typnamespace where t.oid in(select oid from selected_types)),
 'profile', 'BILL03_EVENT_APPLY_NORMAL_PARTNER_PORTFOLIO_CURRENT_OBSERVED_INPUT_V1',
 'history_admission', 'BLOCKED_separate_source_history',
 'named_relations', (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('schema',t.schema_name,'name',t.relation_name,'profile',case when t.test_root then 'new' else 'retained' end,'oid',r.oid) order by t.schema_name,t.relation_name) from named_targets t left join rels r on r.nspname=t.schema_name and r.relname=t.relation_name),
 'expected_functions', (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('signature',signature,'profile',profile,'oid',pg_catalog.to_regprocedure(signature)::oid) order by signature) from expected_functions),
 'missing_functions', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('signature',signature,'profile',profile) order by signature),'[]'::jsonb) from expected_functions where pg_catalog.to_regprocedure(signature) is null),
 'namespaces',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('oid',n.oid,'name',n.nspname,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(n.nspowner),'acl',n.nspacl::text,'access',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('role',r.rolname,'usage',has_schema_privilege(r.oid,n.oid,'USAGE'),'create',has_schema_privilege(r.oid,n.oid,'CREATE')) order by r.rolname) from pg_roles r where r.rolname in('anon','authenticated','service_role','postgres'))) order by n.nspname) from pg_namespace n where n.nspname in('public','private','extensions','auth')),
 'function_dependencies',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('function_oid',d.objid,'reference_class',d.refclassid::regclass::text,'reference_oid',d.refobjid,'reference_subid',d.refobjsubid,'type',d.deptype,'reference',pg_catalog.pg_describe_object(d.refclassid,d.refobjid,d.refobjsubid)) order by d.objid,d.refclassid,d.refobjid,d.refobjsubid),'[]'::jsonb) from function_deps d),
 'unselected_direct_function_references',(
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('oid',p.oid,'schema',n.nspname,'name',p.proname,'identity_arguments',pg_catalog.pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid)) order by n.nspname,p.proname,p.oid),'[]'::jsonb)
  from pg_catalog.pg_proc p join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace
  where p.oid in(
    select d.refobjid from deps d where d.refclassid='pg_catalog.pg_proc'::regclass
    union select d.refobjid from function_deps d where d.refclassid='pg_catalog.pg_proc'::regclass
  ) and not exists(select 1 from function_oids f where f.oid=p.oid)
),
 'root_foreign_keys',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('oid',f.oid,'name',f.conname,'child',f.conrelid::regclass::text,'parent',f.confrelid::regclass::text,'parent_oid',f.confrelid,'child_columns',f.conkey,'parent_columns',f.confkey,'index_oid',f.conindid,'definition',pg_catalog.pg_get_constraintdef(f.oid,true),'validated',f.convalidated,'deferrable',f.condeferrable,'deferred',f.condeferred,'delete_action',f.confdeltype,'update_action',f.confupdtype,'match_type',f.confmatchtype) order by f.conrelid,f.conname),'[]'::jsonb) from root_fks f),
 'parent_key_projections',(
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('schema',n.nspname,'name',c.relname,'oid',c.oid,'kind',c.relkind,'owner',pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner),'acl',c.relacl::text,'namespace_acl',n.nspacl::text,
    'columns',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('number',a.attnum,'name',a.attname,'type_oid',a.atttypid,'type',pg_catalog.format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),'not_null',a.attnotnull,'collation_oid',a.attcollation,'acl',a.attacl::text) order by a.attnum) from pg_catalog.pg_attribute a where a.attrelid=c.oid and a.attnum=any(array(select unnest(f.confkey) from root_fks f where f.confrelid=c.oid))),
    'referenced_indexes',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('oid',i.indexrelid,'definition',pg_catalog.pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid),'unique',i.indisunique,'primary',i.indisprimary,'valid',i.indisvalid,'ready',i.indisready,'nulls_not_distinct',i.indnullsnotdistinct,'key_columns',i.indkey::text,'key_count',i.indnkeyatts,'total_count',i.indnatts,
      'opclasses',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('position',o.pos,'oid',o.oid,'schema',onsp.nspname,'name',oc.opcname,'family_oid',oc.opcfamily,'input_type',oc.opcintype,'default',oc.opcdefault) order by o.pos) from unnest(i.indclass::oid[]) with ordinality o(oid,pos) join pg_catalog.pg_opclass oc on oc.oid=o.oid join pg_catalog.pg_namespace onsp on onsp.oid=oc.opcnamespace),
      'collations',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('position',co.pos,'oid',co.oid,'metadata',to_jsonb(pc)) order by co.pos) from unnest(i.indcollation::oid[]) with ordinality co(oid,pos) left join pg_catalog.pg_collation pc on pc.oid=co.oid),
      'predicate',pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(i.indpred,i.indrelid),'expressions',pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(i.indexprs,i.indrelid),
      'constraints',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('oid',uc.oid,'name',uc.conname,'type',uc.contype,'definition',pg_catalog.pg_get_constraintdef(uc.oid,true),'validated',uc.convalidated,'deferrable',uc.condeferrable,'deferred',uc.condeferred) order by uc.oid) from pg_catalog.pg_constraint uc where uc.conrelid=c.oid and uc.conindid=i.indexrelid)
    ) order by i.indexrelid) from pg_catalog.pg_index i where i.indrelid=c.oid and i.indexrelid in(select f.conindid from root_fks f where f.confrelid=c.oid))
  ) order by n.nspname,c.relname),'[]'::jsonb)
  from parent_oids po join pg_catalog.pg_class c on c.oid=po.oid join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace
),
 'sequences',(
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('oid',s.oid,'schema',n.nspname,'name',s.relname,'owner',pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(s.relowner),'acl',s.relacl::text,
   'configuration',jsonb_build_object('seqrelid',cfg.seqrelid::text,'seqtypid',cfg.seqtypid::text,'seqstart',cfg.seqstart::text,'seqincrement',cfg.seqincrement::text,'seqmax',cfg.seqmax::text,'seqmin',cfg.seqmin::text,'seqcache',cfg.seqcache::text,'seqcycle',cfg.seqcycle),
   'configuration_encoding','integer_config_as_text_no_counter_state',
   'effective_access',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('role',r.rolname,'usage',pg_catalog.has_sequence_privilege(r.oid,s.oid,'USAGE'),'select',pg_catalog.has_sequence_privilege(r.oid,s.oid,'SELECT'),'update',pg_catalog.has_sequence_privilege(r.oid,s.oid,'UPDATE')) order by r.rolname) from pg_catalog.pg_roles r where r.rolname in('anon','authenticated','service_role','postgres')),
   'dependencies',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('class',d.refclassid::regclass::text,'oid',d.refobjid,'subid',d.refobjsubid,'type',d.deptype,'reference',pg_catalog.pg_describe_object(d.refclassid,d.refobjid,d.refobjsubid)) order by d.refclassid,d.refobjid,d.refobjsubid) from pg_catalog.pg_depend d where d.classid='pg_catalog.pg_class'::regclass and d.objid=s.oid)
 ) order by n.nspname,s.relname),'[]'::jsonb)
 from pg_catalog.pg_class s join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.oid=s.relnamespace
 join pg_catalog.pg_sequence cfg on cfg.seqrelid=s.oid where s.oid in(select oid from sequence_oids)
),
 'index_details',(
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table_oid',i.indrelid,'index_oid',i.indexrelid,'name',c.relname,'live',i.indislive,'key_columns',i.indkey::text,'key_count',i.indnkeyatts,'total_count',i.indnatts,'opclass_oids',i.indclass::text,'collation_oids',i.indcollation::text,'options',i.indoption::text) order by i.indrelid,i.indexrelid),'[]'::jsonb)
 from pg_catalog.pg_index i join pg_catalog.pg_class c on c.oid=i.indexrelid where i.indrelid in(select oid from rels)
),
 'trigger_details',(
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table_oid',t.tgrelid,'trigger_oid',t.oid,'function_oid',t.tgfoid,'event_bits',t.tgtype,'update_columns',t.tgattr::text,'argument_count',t.tgnargs,'arguments_hex',encode(t.tgargs,'hex'),'qual_node_tree',t.tgqual::text) order by t.tgrelid,t.tgname),'[]'::jsonb)
 from pg_catalog.pg_trigger t where t.tgrelid in(select oid from rels)
),
 'functions',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('oid',p.oid,'schema',n.nspname,'name',p.proname,'identity_arguments',pg_catalog.pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid),'result',pg_catalog.pg_get_function_result(p.oid),'owner',pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner),'acl',p.proacl::text,'language',l.lanname,'kind',p.prokind,'security_definer',p.prosecdef,'volatility',p.provolatile,'strict',p.proisstrict,'parallel',p.proparallel,'leakproof',p.proleakproof,'config',p.proconfig,'definition',case when n.nspname<>'pg_catalog' and p.prokind in('f','p') then pg_catalog.pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) else null end,'effective_execute',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('role',r.rolname,'execute',has_function_privilege(r.oid,p.oid,'EXECUTE')) order by r.rolname) from pg_catalog.pg_roles r where r.rolname in('anon','authenticated','service_role','postgres')),'extension',(select jsonb_build_object('name',e.extname,'version',e.extversion) from pg_catalog.pg_depend d join pg_catalog.pg_extension e on e.oid=d.refobjid and d.refclassid='pg_catalog.pg_extension'::regclass where d.classid='pg_catalog.pg_proc'::regclass and d.objid=p.oid and d.deptype='e')) order by n.nspname,p.proname,p.oid),'[]'::jsonb) from pg_catalog.pg_proc p join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace join pg_catalog.pg_language l on l.oid=p.prolang where p.oid in(select oid from function_oids)),
 'tables', (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('schema',n.nspname,'name',c.relname,'kind',c.relkind,'owner',pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner),'rls',c.relrowsecurity,'force_rls',c.relforcerowsecurity,'acl',c.relacl::text,
   'policies',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',p.polname,'command',p.polcmd,'permissive',p.polpermissive,'roles',(select jsonb_agg(case when r.oid=0 then 'PUBLIC' else pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(r.oid) end order by r.oid) from unnest(p.polroles) as r(oid)),'using',pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(p.polqual,p.polrelid),'with_check',pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(p.polwithcheck,p.polrelid)) order by p.polname),'[]'::jsonb) from pg_catalog.pg_policy p where p.polrelid=c.oid),
   'classification',(select to_jsonb(t) from public.platform_table_classification t where t.table_name=c.relname),
   'oid',c.oid,'schema_owner',pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(n.nspowner),'schema_acl',n.nspacl::text,'options',c.reloptions,'view_definition',case when c.relkind in('v','m') then pg_catalog.pg_get_viewdef(c.oid,true) else null end,
   'columns',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('number',a.attnum,'name',a.attname,'type_oid',a.atttypid,'type',pg_catalog.format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),'not_null',a.attnotnull,'identity',a.attidentity,'generated',a.attgenerated,'inherited_count',a.attinhcount,'is_local',a.attislocal,'collation_oid',a.attcollation,'default',pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(d.adbin,d.adrelid),'acl',a.attacl::text) order by a.attnum),'[]'::jsonb) from pg_catalog.pg_attribute a left join pg_catalog.pg_attrdef d on d.adrelid=a.attrelid and d.adnum=a.attnum where a.attrelid=c.oid and a.attnum>0 and not a.attisdropped),
   'constraints',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('oid',f.oid,'name',f.conname,'type',f.contype,'definition',pg_catalog.pg_get_constraintdef(f.oid,true),'validated',f.convalidated,'deferrable',f.condeferrable,'deferred',f.condeferred,'columns',f.conkey,'parent',case when f.confrelid<>0 then f.confrelid::regclass::text else null end,'parent_oid',f.confrelid,'parent_columns',f.confkey,'parent_key_metadata',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('number',a.attnum,'name',a.attname,'type',pg_catalog.format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),'not_null',a.attnotnull) order by a.attnum) from pg_catalog.pg_attribute a where a.attrelid=f.confrelid and a.attnum=any(f.confkey)),'delete_action',f.confdeltype,'update_action',f.confupdtype,'match_type',f.confmatchtype,'index_oid',f.conindid) order by f.conname),'[]'::jsonb) from pg_catalog.pg_constraint f where f.conrelid=c.oid),
   'indexes',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('oid',i.indexrelid,'definition',pg_catalog.pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid),'unique',i.indisunique,'primary',i.indisprimary,'valid',i.indisvalid,'ready',i.indisready,'nulls_not_distinct',i.indnullsnotdistinct,'predicate',pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(i.indpred,i.indrelid),'expressions',pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(i.indexprs,i.indrelid)) order by i.indexrelid),'[]'::jsonb) from pg_catalog.pg_index i where i.indrelid=c.oid),
   'triggers',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('oid',t.oid,'name',t.tgname,'enabled',t.tgenabled,'internal',t.tgisinternal,'function_oid',t.tgfoid,'constraint_oid',t.tgconstraint,'definition',pg_catalog.pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid,true)) order by t.tgname),'[]'::jsonb) from pg_catalog.pg_trigger t where t.tgrelid=c.oid),
   'rules',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('oid',r.oid,'name',r.rulename,'event',r.ev_type,'enabled',r.ev_enabled,'instead',r.is_instead,'definition',pg_catalog.pg_get_ruledef(r.oid,true)) order by r.rulename),'[]'::jsonb) from pg_catalog.pg_rewrite r where r.ev_class=c.oid),
   'column_acls',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('column',a.attname,'acl',a.attacl::text) order by a.attnum),'[]'::jsonb) from pg_catalog.pg_attribute a where a.attrelid=c.oid and a.attnum>0 and not a.attisdropped and a.attacl is not null),
   'effective_access',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('role',r.rolname,'select',has_table_privilege(r.oid,c.oid,'SELECT'),'insert',has_table_privilege(r.oid,c.oid,'INSERT'),'update',has_table_privilege(r.oid,c.oid,'UPDATE'),'delete',has_table_privilege(r.oid,c.oid,'DELETE'),'schema_usage',has_schema_privilege(r.oid,n.oid,'USAGE')) order by r.rolname) from pg_catalog.pg_roles r where r.rolname in ('anon','authenticated','service_role'))
 ) order by c.relname) from pg_catalog.pg_class c join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where c.oid in(select oid from rels))
) as catalog_receipt;

constraints.name: billing_underlays_configuration_snapshot_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (billing_configuration_snapshot IS NULL AND billing_configuration_snapshot_sha256 IS NULL AND billing_configuration_snapshotted_at IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(billing_configuration_snapshot) = 'object'::text AND billing_configuration_snapshot_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text AND billing_configuration_snapshotted_at IS NOT NULL)

constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.definition: CHECK (status <> 'exported'::text OR validated_at IS NOT NULL OR received_at IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: billing_underlays_grid_owner_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (grid_owner_id) REFERENCES grid_owners(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: billing_underlays_metering_point_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (metering_point_id) REFERENCES metering_points(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: billing_underlays_month_valid_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (underlay_month >= 1 AND underlay_month <= 12 AND underlay_year >= 2000 AND underlay_year <= 2100)

constraints.name: billing_underlays_period_order_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (billing_period_start IS NULL OR billing_period_end IS NULL OR billing_period_end > billing_period_start)

constraints.name: billing_underlays_portfolio_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (portfolio_id) REFERENCES portfolios(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: billing_underlays_portfolio_monthly_settlement_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (portfolio_monthly_settlement_id) REFERENCES portfolio_monthly_settlements(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: billing_underlays_site_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (site_id) REFERENCES customer_sites(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: billing_underlays_source_request_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (source_request_id) REFERENCES grid_owner_data_requests(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: billing_underlays_validated_requires_received_at
constraints.definition: CHECK (status <> 'validated'::text OR received_at IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: billing_underlays_vat_rate_fraction_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (vat_rate IS NULL OR vat_rate >= 0::numeric AND vat_rate <= 1::numeric)

constraints.name: billing_underlays_vat_rate_fraction_contract
constraints.definition: CHECK (vat_rate IS NULL OR vat_rate >= 0::numeric AND vat_rate <= 1::numeric)

constraints.name: customer_contracts_active_requires_signed_at
constraints.definition: CHECK (status <> 'active'::text OR signed_at IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: customer_contracts_auto_renew_requires_term
constraints.definition: CHECK (auto_renew_enabled = false OR COALESCE(auto_renew_term_months, binding_months) IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: customer_contracts_billing_identity_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (billing_eligible_at IS NULL OR contract_price_snapshot_id IS NOT NULL AND contract_product_version_id IS NOT NULL AND contract_publication_version_id IS NOT NULL AND (price_area_used = ANY (ARRAY['SE1'::text, 'SE2'::text, 'SE3'::text, 'SE4'::text])) AND NULLIF(snapshot_hash, ''::text) IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: customer_contracts_closed_states_require_end_or_notice
constraints.definition: CHECK ((status <> ALL (ARRAY['terminated'::text, 'cancelled'::text, 'expired'::text])) OR ends_at IS NOT NULL OR termination_notice_date IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: customer_contracts_company_customer_customer_site_rel_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, customer_id, customer_site_id) REFERENCES customer_sites(company_id, customer_id, id)

constraints.name: customer_contracts_company_customer_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, customer_id) REFERENCES customers(company_id, id)

constraints.name: customer_contracts_company_customer_site_rel_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, customer_id, site_id) REFERENCES customer_sites(company_id, customer_id, id)

constraints.name: customer_contracts_company_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id) REFERENCES companies(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, metering_point_id) REFERENCES metering_points(company_id, id)

constraints.name: customer_contracts_company_site_alias_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, site_id) REFERENCES customer_sites(company_id, id)

constraints.name: customer_contracts_company_site_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, customer_site_id) REFERENCES customer_sites(company_id, id)

constraints.name: customer_contracts_contract_offer_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (contract_offer_id) REFERENCES contract_offers(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: customer_contracts_customer_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: customer_contracts_ends_not_before_starts
constraints.definition: CHECK (starts_at IS NULL OR ends_at IS NULL OR ends_at >= starts_at)

constraints.name: customer_contracts_price_plan_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (price_plan_id) REFERENCES price_plans(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: customer_contracts_price_plan_version_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (price_plan_version_id) REFERENCES price_plan_versions(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: customer_contracts_public_contract_offer_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (public_contract_offer_id) REFERENCES public_contract_offers(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: customer_contracts_site_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (site_id) REFERENCES customer_sites(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: customer_contracts_termination_reason_requires_notice
constraints.definition: CHECK (termination_reason IS NULL OR termination_notice_date IS NOT NULL OR (status = ANY (ARRAY['cancelled'::text, 'terminated'::text, 'expired'::text])))

constraints.name: customer_contracts_vat_rate_fraction_contract
constraints.definition: CHECK (vat_rate IS NULL OR vat_rate >= 0::numeric AND vat_rate <= 1::numeric)

constraints.name: mt_customer_contracts_customer_id_tenant_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, customer_id) REFERENCES customers(company_id, id)

functions.name: gridex_emit_partner_resource_event_v2
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.gridex_emit_partner_resource_event_v2(p_company_id uuid, p_customer_id uuid, p_event_type text, p_aggregate_type text, p_aggregate_reference text, p_data jsonb, p_idempotency_key text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'extensions', 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_event_id uuid;
  v_tenant_reference text;
  v_customer_reference text;
  v_customer_number text;
  v_public_event_id text;
  v_public_payload jsonb;
begin
  if p_company_id is null
     or p_customer_id is null
     or nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_event_type,'')),'') is null
     or nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_aggregate_reference,'')),'') is null
     or nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_idempotency_key,'')),'') is null
  then
    return;
  end if;

  select c.external_tenant_reference
  into v_tenant_reference
  from public.companies c
  where c.id = p_company_id
  limit 1;

  select customer_reference, customer_number
  into v_customer_reference, v_customer_number
  from public.customers
  where id = p_customer_id and company_id = p_company_id
  limit 1;

  if nullif(btrim(coalesce(v_tenant_reference,'')),'') is null
     or nullif(btrim(coalesce(v_customer_reference,'')),'') is null
  then
    return;
  end if;

  insert into public.domain_events(
    company_id,
    event_type,
    aggregate_type,
    aggregate_id,
    subject_customer_id,
    source,
    idempotency_key,
    payload
  ) values (
    p_company_id,
    p_event_type,
    p_aggregate_type,
    p_aggregate_reference,
    p_customer_id,
    'partner_api_resource_trigger_v2',
    p_idempotency_key,
    coalesce(p_data,'{}'::jsonb)
  )
  on conflict do nothing
  returning id into v_event_id;

  if v_event_id is null then
    select id into v_event_id
    from public.domain_events
    where company_id = p_company_id
      and idempotency_key = p_idempotency_key
    order by created_at desc
    limit 1;
  end if;

  if v_event_id is null then
    return;
  end if;

  v_public_event_id :=
    'event_' || substr(
      encode(
        extensions.digest(convert_to(p_company_id::text || ':' || v_event_id::text, 'utf8'), 'sha256'),
        'hex'
      ),
      1,
      32
    );

  v_public_payload := jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
    'event_id', v_public_event_id,
    'event_type', p_event_type,
    'created_at', now(),
    'tenant_reference', v_tenant_reference,
    'aggregate', jsonb_build_object(
      'type', p_aggregate_type,
      'reference', p_aggregate_reference
    ),
    'customer', jsonb_build_object(
      'customer_reference', v_customer_reference,
      'customer_number', v_customer_number
    ),
    'data', coalesce(p_data,'{}'::jsonb),
    'contract_schema_version', '2026-08-16.2'
  ));

  insert into public.webhook_deliveries(
    company_id,
    webhook_subscription_id,
    domain_event_id,
    event_type,
    status,
    attempts,
    max_attempts,
    next_attempt_at,
    target_url,
    idempotency_key,
    payload
  )
  select
    subscription.company_id,
    subscription.id,
    v_event_id,
    p_event_type,
    'queued',
    0,
    subscription.max_attempts,
    now(),
    subscription.endpoint_url,
    'webhook:' || subscription.id::text || ':' || v_event_id::text,
    v_public_payload
  from public.webhook_subscriptions subscription
  where subscription.company_id = p_company_id
    and subscription.status = 'active'
    and (
      subscription.event_types @> array[p_event_type]::text[]
      or subscription.event_types @> array['*']::text[]
    )
  on conflict (idempotency_key) do nothing;
end
$function$
functions.identity_arguments: p_company_id uuid, p_customer_id uuid, p_event_type text, p_aggregate_type text, p_aggregate_reference text, p_data jsonb, p_idempotency_key text

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.gridex_partner_invoice_event_v2()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_event_type text;
begin
  if not exists (
    select 1
    from public.customers customer
    where customer.id = new.customer_id
      and customer.company_id = new.company_id
      and coalesce(customer.metadata->>'source_channel','') = 'partner_api'
  ) then
    return new;
  end if;
  v_event_type := case when tg_op='INSERT' then 'invoice.created' else 'invoice.updated' end;
  perform private.gridex_emit_partner_resource_event_v2(
    new.company_id,
    new.customer_id,
    v_event_type,
    'invoice',
    new.invoice_reference,
    jsonb_build_object('status',new.status,'invoice_reference',new.invoice_reference,'due_date',new.due_date),
    'partner:' || v_event_type || ':' || new.id::text || ':' || coalesce(new.updated_at::text,new.created_at::text,now()::text)
  );
  return new;
end
$function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.gridex_audit_portfolio_settlement_write()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
  insert into public.portfolio_settlement_audit_log(
    company_id,portfolio_id,settlement_id,actor_user_id,permission,action,
    old_values,new_values,reason,calculation_snapshot_sha256,approval
  ) values(
    case when tg_op='INSERT' then new.company_id else old.company_id end,
    case when tg_op='INSERT' then new.portfolio_id else old.portfolio_id end,
    case when tg_op='INSERT' then new.id else old.id end,
    case
      when tg_op='INSERT' then new.created_by
      when new.locked_by is distinct from old.locked_by then new.locked_by
      when new.approved_by is distinct from old.approved_by then new.approved_by
      when new.reviewed_by is distinct from old.reviewed_by then new.reviewed_by
      when new.calculated_by is distinct from old.calculated_by then new.calculated_by
      else coalesce(
        nullif(current_setting('gridex.portfolio_actor_user_id',true), '')::uuid,
        new.created_by
      )
    end,
    case
      when tg_op='INSERT' then case when new.source='import' then 'portfolio_settlement.import' else 'portfolio_settlement.create' end
      when new.is_current=false and old.is_current then 'portfolio_settlement.correct'
      when new.status='calculated' and old.status is distinct from new.status then 'portfolio_settlement.calculate'
      when new.status='reviewed' and old.status is distinct from new.status then 'portfolio_settlement.review'
      when new.status='final' and old.status is distinct from new.status then 'portfolio_settlement.approve'
      when new.status='locked' and old.status is distinct from new.status then 'portfolio_settlement.lock'
      else 'portfolio_settlement.correct'
    end,
    case
      when tg_op='INSERT' then 'settlement.created'
      when new.is_current=false and old.is_current then 'settlement.superseded'
      when new.status is distinct from old.status then 'settlement.'||new.status
      else 'settlement.updated'
    end,
    case when tg_op='INSERT' then null else to_jsonb(old) end,
    case when tg_op='DELETE' then null else to_jsonb(new) end,
    coalesce(
      nullif(current_setting('gridex.portfolio_audit_reason',true),''),
      case when tg_op='INSERT' then new.correction_reason else coalesce(new.correction_reason,old.correction_reason) end
    ),
    new.calculation_snapshot_sha256,
    case
      when new.approved_by is not null then jsonb_build_object('approved_by',new.approved_by,'approved_at',new.approved_at)
      else null
    end
  );
  return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.gridex_claim_invoice_provider_events(p_company_id uuid, p_statuses text[], p_limit integer, p_processing_token uuid, p_max_age_days integer DEFAULT 365)
 RETURNS SETOF invoice_provider_events
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if p_processing_token is null or p_statuses is null or coalesce(array_length(p_statuses,1),0)=0
     or p_limit is null or p_limit < 1 or p_limit > 500
     or p_max_age_days is null or p_max_age_days < 1 or p_max_age_days > 3650 then
    raise exception 'invalid_provider_event_claim_arguments' using errcode='22023';
  end if;
  if exists(select 1 from unnest(p_statuses) s where s not in ('received','needs_review','failed')) then
    raise exception 'invalid_provider_event_claim_status' using errcode='22023';
  end if;

  return query
  with candidates as (
    select e.id
      from public.invoice_provider_events e
     where e.company_id is not null
       and (p_company_id is null or e.company_id=p_company_id)
       and e.received_at >= clock_timestamp()-(p_max_age_days::text||' days')::interval
       and (
         e.status=any(p_statuses)
         or (e.status='processing' and e.processing_started_at < clock_timestamp()-interval '15 minutes')
       )
     order by e.received_at,e.id
     for update skip locked
     limit p_limit
  ), claimed as (
    update public.invoice_provider_events e
       set status='processing',
           processing_token=p_processing_token,
           processing_started_at=clock_timestamp(),
           attempt_count=coalesce(e.attempt_count,0)+1,
           failure_reason=null
      from candidates c
     where e.id=c.id
     returning e.*
  )
  select * from claimed;
end;
$function$
functions.identity_arguments: p_company_id uuid, p_statuses text[], p_limit integer, p_processing_token uuid, p_max_age_days integer

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.gridex_guard_portfolio_invoice_evidence()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
  if tg_op = 'UPDATE' and old.status in ('issued', 'sent', 'exported', 'paid') and (
    new.portfolio_id is distinct from old.portfolio_id
    or new.customer_contract_id is distinct from old.customer_contract_id
    or new.price_plan_version_id is distinct from old.price_plan_version_id
    or new.portfolio_monthly_settlement_id is distinct from old.portfolio_monthly_settlement_id
    or new.portfolio_settlement_revision is distinct from old.portfolio_settlement_revision
    or new.portfolio_settlement_sha256 is distinct from old.portfolio_settlement_sha256
    or new.portfolio_settlement_snapshot is distinct from old.portfolio_settlement_snapshot
    or new.portfolio_price_area_code is distinct from old.portfolio_price_area_code
    or new.portfolio_delivery_month is distinct from old.portfolio_delivery_month
    or new.portfolio_price_ore_per_kwh is distinct from old.portfolio_price_ore_per_kwh
    or new.portfolio_management_fee_ore_per_kwh is distinct from old.portfolio_management_fee_ore_per_kwh
    or new.portfolio_gross_energy_cost_sek is distinct from old.portfolio_gross_energy_cost_sek
    or new.portfolio_energy_volume_kwh is distinct from old.portfolio_energy_volume_kwh
    or new.delivery_month is distinct from old.delivery_month
    or new.price_area_code is distinct from old.price_area_code
    or new.consumption_kwh is distinct from old.consumption_kwh
    or new.portfolio_share_percent is distinct from old.portfolio_share_percent
    or new.spot_share_percent is distinct from old.spot_share_percent
    or new.fixed_share_percent is distinct from old.fixed_share_percent
    or new.fixed_price_sek_per_kwh is distinct from old.fixed_price_sek_per_kwh
    or new.portfolio_energy_cost_sek is distinct from old.portfolio_energy_cost_sek
    or new.spot_energy_cost_sek is distinct from old.spot_energy_cost_sek
    or new.fixed_energy_cost_sek is distinct from old.fixed_energy_cost_sek
    or new.management_fee_sek is distinct from old.management_fee_sek
    or new.other_fees_sek is distinct from old.other_fees_sek
    or new.vat_rate is distinct from old.vat_rate
    or new.calculation_snapshot is distinct from old.calculation_snapshot
    or new.calculation_snapshot_sha256 is distinct from old.calculation_snapshot_sha256
  ) then
    raise exception using errcode = '55000', message = 'issued_invoice_portfolio_evidence_immutable';
  end if;

  if new.status in ('issued', 'sent', 'exported', 'paid')
     and new.portfolio_id is not null
     and (
       new.portfolio_monthly_settlement_id is null
       or new.portfolio_settlement_status <> 'locked'
       or nullif(new.portfolio_settlement_sha256, '') is null
       or coalesce(new.portfolio_settlement_snapshot, '{}'::jsonb) = '{}'::jsonb
       or new.customer_contract_id is null
       or new.price_plan_version_id is null
       or new.delivery_month is null
       or new.price_area_code is null
       or new.consumption_kwh is null
       or new.portfolio_share_percent is null
       or new.spot_share_percent is null
       or new.fixed_share_percent is null
       or abs(
         new.portfolio_share_percent
         + new.spot_share_percent
         + new.fixed_share_percent
         - 100
       ) > 0.000001
       or new.portfolio_energy_cost_sek is null
       or new.spot_energy_cost_sek is null
       or new.fixed_energy_cost_sek is null
       or (new.fixed_share_percent > 0 and new.fixed_price_sek_per_kwh is null)
       or new.management_fee_sek is null
       or new.other_fees_sek is null
       or new.vat_rate is null
       or nullif(new.calculation_snapshot_sha256, '') is null
       or coalesce(new.calculation_snapshot, '{}'::jsonb) = '{}'::jsonb
     ) then
    raise exception using errcode = '23514', message = 'final_invoice_requires_locked_portfolio_settlement_evidence';
  end if;
  return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.gridex_normalize_billing_energy_flow()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
  new.energy_direction:=case
    when coalesce(nullif(new.payload->>'energy_direction',''),new.energy_direction)='production' then 'production'
    when coalesce(nullif(new.payload->>'energy_direction',''),new.energy_direction)='consumption_correction' then 'consumption_correction'
    else 'consumption' end;
  new.settlement_type:=case
    when new.energy_direction='production' and coalesce(nullif(new.payload->>'settlement_type',''),new.settlement_type)='self_billing' then 'self_billing'
    when new.energy_direction='production' then 'credit_invoice'
    when new.energy_direction='consumption_correction' then 'credit_invoice'
    else 'invoice' end;
  if new.total_kwh is not null and new.total_kwh<0 then
    raise exception using errcode='23514',message='billing_underlay_quantity_must_be_positive_direction_is_separate';
  end if;
  return new;
end $function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.gridex_sync_underlay_invoice_projection_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_export_run_id uuid;
begin
  if new.company_id is null or new.customer_id is null or new.billing_underlay_id is null then
    return new;
  end if;

  if new.invoice_export_item_id is not null then
    select iei.export_run_id
      into v_export_run_id
      from public.invoice_export_items iei
     where iei.id = new.invoice_export_item_id
       and iei.company_id = new.company_id
       and iei.customer_id = new.customer_id;
  end if;

  update public.billing_underlays bu
     set invoice_readiness_status = case
           when new.status = 'draft' then 'ready_for_invoice'
           when new.status in ('issued', 'sent', 'paid', 'overdue') then 'invoiced'
           when new.status = 'credited' then 'credited'
           when new.status = 'cancelled' then 'cancelled'
           when new.status = 'failed' then 'needs_review'
           else coalesce(bu.invoice_readiness_status, 'pending')
         end,
         invoice_export_run_id = coalesce(v_export_run_id, bu.invoice_export_run_id),
         invoice_export_locked_at = case
           when new.status in ('issued', 'sent', 'paid', 'overdue', 'credited')
             then coalesce(bu.invoice_export_locked_at, now())
           else bu.invoice_export_locked_at
         end,
         updated_at = now()
   where bu.id = new.billing_underlay_id
     and bu.company_id = new.company_id
     and bu.customer_id = new.customer_id;

  if not found then
    raise exception using
      errcode = '23514',
      message = 'invoice_projection_underlay_customer_mismatch';
  end if;

  return new;
end
$function$
